justification: Standard: 3 new UI components (EmailGate, BlogEmailCapture, intelligence-brief checkout) + integration across 7 tool pages + 1 layout + 6 test files updated + 2 new test files. No DB changes. All lead API calls use existing endpoint. Intelligence brief checkout copies proven pattern from 8 existing routes.

pre_impl.existing_data: lead API table (canibuildit_leads) — new rows only. localStorage key 'plotdetect_email'. Stripe sessions via existing checkout pattern.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If lead API is down, email capture silently fails — user still sees content (EmailGate unlocks optimistically). No data loss, just missed lead capture.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New leads only. EmailGate localStorage is per-browser. No existing rows affected.

functions.input: address: string, product: string, children: ReactNode
functions.output: renders email form or children based on localStorage
functions.if_none: address='' still works — sends empty value to lead API

functions.name: BlogEmailCapture
functions.input: no external props — renders self-contained email capture form
functions.output: renders email form, POSTs to /api/canibuildit/lead with interest_type='blog-subscriber'

functions.input: { address: string, prop_id?: string, email?: string }
functions.output: JSON response with checkout_url string for Stripe redirect

Checkout blocked with error — correct behavior

break_it.scenario: User clears localStorage between EmailGate unlock and checkout — sees gate again on refresh
break_it.what_happens: User re-enters email, content re-appears. Duplicate lead entry in DB.
break_it.how: EmailGate.tsx:44 — stores on submit, re-reads on mount. Duplicate leads are harmless.
break_it.repro: Open flood tool → enter email → clear localStorage → refresh → gate re-appears

break_it.scenario: BlogEmailCapture on blog index page (/blog) — double CTA alongside per-post CTA
break_it.what_happens: Users see email capture on listing page too. Redundant but not harmful.
break_it.how: blog/layout.tsx wraps all children. Low priority — could add pathname check later.
break_it.repro: Navigate to /blog → scroll to bottom → see BlogEmailCapture

break_it.scenario: Intelligence brief checkout without STRIPE_INTELLIGENCE_BRIEF_PRICE_ID env var
break_it.what_happens: Returns 500 'Payment not configured'. Console logs the error.
break_it.how: intelligence-brief/route.ts:35-38 — explicit env var check before Stripe API call

post_merge.secrets: STRIPE_INTELLIGENCE_BRIEF_PRICE_ID env var must be set in Vercel for intelligence brief checkout
post_merge.manual_verify: Check EmailGate on flood/shadow/solar/granny-flat/conveyancing/pre-da-history tool pages. Check BlogEmailCapture on any blog post. Check /blog index for double-CTA.
